description: initial evaluation of eval.md and prompt.md
added Post-Ceiling Protocol with 5 ordered strategies and consecutive-discard exit
replaced crypto/VC-specific anchors in Clarity with audience-agnostic "{target audience}" language
generalized Hook dimension: removed "first 5 seconds", added "audience" over "viewer", format-agnostic anchors
added anti-inflation rules: max 2 dimensions per change, strict 10 definition "cannot imagine better"
added voice floor rule: Voice below 6 caps final average at 6.0 — structural protection against voice erosion
added 8th dimension: PRODUCTION DIRECTION — covers sound, typography, timing, format, color as rhetorical devices
added tie-breaking, atomic change definition, discard memory, and dimension trade-off protection rules
renamed ESCALATION to NARRATIVE ARC — generalized from montage-specific to any format with argument/emotion/stakes
renamed VISUAL IMAGINATION to VISUAL NARRATIVE — sharpened boundary with Production Direction, emphasizes independent meaning track
enriched Rhythm & Pacing anchors with specific repair cues: tempo changes, sentence length variation, silence as punctuation
added VIDEO_TYPE and TARGET_AUDIENCE template variables with format examples, updated dimension count to 8
added dimension independence guide: named each axis (FIRST IMPRESSION, SEQUENCING, TIME, etc.) with isolation test
restructured post-ceiling into 5 phased protocol with iteration budgets, exit conditions, and stability endgame
raised voice floor to 7, added voice cross-check rule for Clarity/Rhythm/Closing scoring
added "swap test" to Narrative Arc anchors — each level defined by what rearrangement would break
added Iteration Phases guide: structural changes when avg<5, section rewrites 5-7, line polish 7-8.5, production 8.5+
generalized Voice dimension: removed Cioran-specific references, added universal "rewriting in neutral voice loses meaning" test
enriched Closing Power anchors with repair cues: callback/reframe/reversal at 7, "answers unasked question" at 10
added read-aloud test: scores above 7 must pass a felt-quality gate, not just anchor description matching
clarified Production Direction boundary: "not what the script says or how it flows", separated from Rhythm
added Cross-Cutting Concerns section: duration fit and audience calibration as scoring modifiers
fixed dimension count bug (7→8 in re-evaluate step), removed stale Known Issues section
added "The 7-to-10 Gap" section with qualitative boundaries at each level and diagnostic test for 8 vs 9 vs 10
enriched Opening Hook anchors: each level now names the failure mode AND implies the fix (unanswered question at 7)
renamed header from "Method 2: Sectioned Scoring" to "Video Script Autoresearch" — removes method-numbering, generalizes framing
added rubric-ceiling acknowledgment: 10/10 means "maxed this rubric" not "perfect", asks for unscored improvement notes
added emotional throughline as cross-cutting concern: emergent from Voice+Arc+Closing, flags when they combine poorly
wove voice into Clarity's 10-anchor: "clarity achieved THROUGH the voice, not despite it" — structural voice protection
added impact estimation to IDEATE step: root cause > symptom, highest expected impact question
added edge cases: empty scripts, voice-dimension conflicts, non-visual format handling with dimension exclusion
added parenthetical distinguishing Closing Power from Narrative Arc in dimension guide — minor clarification, no score change
added independent justification rule: each dimension must reference DIFFERENT evidence, same-line justifications flag correlation
added post-ceiling output document: audience brief, quotable lines, known weakness, rubric gap — structured value from ceiling iterations
extended voice cross-check to ALL dimensions above 7, not just Clarity/Rhythm/Closing — total structural voice protection
added diagnostic ladder for 8/9/10 distinction with "generosity is inflation" tiebreaker
added "substance over presence" rule: anchors reward specificity/intentionality, shallow matches score one level below
added feasibility check to IDEATE step, restructured as 3 sub-bullets — marginal clarity improvement
fixed stale "Escalation" → "Narrative Arc" in tie-breaking, renamed categories to architecture/execution
added 5 concrete techniques to Visual Narrative 7-anchor: metaphor, data overlay, juxtaposition, progressive reveal, running element
added internal consistency cross-cutting concern: catches self-contradicting scripts (format vs content, header vs body)
added Calibration step: baseline gut-check, re-read anchors if scores diverge from feel, reduces inter-run variance
generalized iteration phases: defined structure/section/line in format-agnostic terms, added "experienced" for text formats
added pattern recognition checkpoint every 10 iterations: learn which change types work, pivot deliberately
added independence test with specific co-movement traps for Narrative Arc/Rhythm and Visual Narrative/Production Direction
stress test: evaluated removing voice floor — confirmed it's load-bearing (voice preservation would drop to ~8 without it)
stress test: evaluated removing "substance over presence" — confirmed it's complementary to read-aloud test, both load-bearing
stress test: evaluated removing iteration phases — convergence would drop to ~7 (structural fixes before polish is critical)
polish: aligned title to "Video Script Evaluation Rubric" — matches prompt naming convention
resolved atomic/structural contradiction: added exception for avg<5 where structural changes exceed normal atomic scope
final stability confirmation — all 10 meta-dimensions at 10, both files clean and internally consistent
